scripts.dev:api: cd apps/thesis-radar/api && uv run uvicorn thesis_radar_api.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.pipeline: cd signal-engine && uv sync && uv run python -m signal_engine.pipeline
scripts.pipeline:dry-run: cd signal-engine && uv sync && uv run python -m signal_engine.pipeline --dry-run
scripts.pipeline:soc2: cd signal-engine && uv sync && uv run python -m signal_engine.pipeline --thesis config/thesis_soc2_compliance.yaml
